description: Models the P&L impact of exchange rate moves on the user's current net exposure (invoices + cash) and existing hedges. Four modes: (1) supply explicit `scenarios` for a linear what-if, e.g. 'What happens if GBP/EUR moves 3% before Q3 close?'; (2) set `worst_case: true` (scenarios optional) to revalue each currency at its OWN worst adverse 30-day historical move, the same worst-case the Monitor dashboard shows; (3) `adverse_pct` for one uniform move against every position; (4) `base_move_pct` for the base currency moving against all foreign currencies (negative = base weaker). Worst-case is a historical realised downside, not a forecast or a recommendation. Cross-currency pairs (neither leg is the reporting currency) are shocked base-neutrally.

adverse_pct.description: Uniform adverse move: each currency moves this percentage against its own net position after open forwards (a net receivable currency weakens, a net payable currency strengthens), so every row is a loss. Use for 'a 10% adverse move' or 'everything moves 10% against me'. scenarios becomes optional.

base_move_pct.description: The base currency moves this percentage against every foreign currency. Negative = base WEAKER (e.g. 'ZAR 10% weaker' on a ZAR book is -10), positive = base stronger. Use this instead of composing pairs for a base-currency move. scenarios becomes optional.

horizon_days.description: Forward-looking exposure window included in the simulation.

include_hedges.description: Apply offsetting effect of existing hedges. Set false to see gross (unhedged) impact.

scenarios.description: Rate shocks to apply (required unless worst_case is true). Multiple entries are applied simultaneously (correlated move).

currency_pair.description: Currency pair, e.g. 'GBPEUR' or 'EUR/GBP'. Base currency strengthens when shock_bps is positive.

shock_bps.description: Rate shock in basis points. Positive = base currency strengthens. 300 = +3%.

worst_case.description: When true, ignore linear shocks and apply each currency's own worst adverse 30-day historical move (adverse-aligned, always a loss). Matches the Monitor worst-case KPI when every exposed currency receives a move; partial coverage is reported in worst_case.coverage and worst_case.coverage_complete, and a partial gross_impact_base covers only the currencies listed in by_currency. scenarios becomes optional.

name: simulate_scenario

outputSchema.description: Hedgr MCP envelope. Inspect connection_status.state before relying on data. Mirrors mcp/schema/connection_status.json (inlined because MCP hosts do not resolve external $refs reliably).

connected_systems.description: Identifiers of connected accounting systems, e.g. ['xero:acme-uk', 'qbo:acme-us'].

last_sync.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of most recent successful data sync.

missing_systems.description: Entity IDs configured in policy but not yet connected. Present in 'partial' state.

setup_options.description: Available Hedgr setup surfaces to mention without implying a single provider path.

setup_reason.description: Plain-English reason Hedgr cannot answer with exposure data yet.

setup_steps.description: Ordered next steps the assistant should show when state is setup_required, including Save workspace to cloud for CSV/manual workspaces.

setup_url.description: Deep link to Hedgr settings/setup. Present when state is 'setup_required' or 'partial'.

state.description: ready: at least one server-readable source is connected, such as an accounting provider, Google Sheets, or saved CSV/manual cloud workspace, with data fresh (<24h). setup_required: no server-readable source is connected, data is null - surface setup_url and setup_steps. partial: some entities/sections connected, data covers only connected entities/sections. stale: connected but last_sync >24h - warn before executing.

data.description: Tool-specific payload. Null when connection_status.state is 'setup_required'.
